title: Autumn 2026 — Teide Epic

blocks.title: Pre-USA
blocks.focus: Hold CTL ~63–66 on the current riding, given a repeatable shape. Even weekly load.

blocks.title: USA trip

blocks.title: Base 3

blocks.title: Specificity
